student_will_learn: Explain what Block Public Access is and why it acts as a master switch
Write a bucket policy that grants access to a specific principal
Generate and use a pre-signed URL for temporary, controlled access
Explain the difference between server-side and client-side encryption options
Identify why disabling Block Public Access 'temporarily' is a serious, recurring risk

ava_lesson_intro.ava_speaks: Last lesson-ல நாம storage classes பார்த்தோம். இப்போ CFO-ஓட FQ-189 ticket-ல அடுத்த கவலை - 'நம்ம S3 buckets-ல sensitive data இருக்கு, அது accidental-ஆ public-ஆ exposed ஆகாதுனு எப்படி உறுதி பண்றது?' இதுதான் இன்னைக்கு நாம கத்துக்கப் போற S3 Security.

lines: Building Basics · Session CS5 · Lesson C5.2
Ticket FQ-189 — continuing with CFO's Office

blocks.block_title: Block Public Access — The Master Switch
blocks.ava_speaks: S3-ல security-ஓட முதல் layer - Block Public Access. இது ஒரு account-level அல்லது bucket-level 'master switch' - இது ON-ஆ இருந்தா, bucket policy அல்லது object ACL எவ்ளோ permissive-ஆ இருந்தாலும், public access சாத்தியமே இல்ல. இது தான் safety net - individual policies-ல ஒரு mistake நடந்தாலும், இது overall protection தரும். Bucket policies, specific principals (IAM users, roles, accounts)-க்கு access grant பண்ண use பண்றோம் - Block Public Access OFF ஆகி இருந்தா மட்டும் தான் இது public access-ஐயும் grant பண்ண முடியும்.

board_actions.text: Block Public Access Is a Safety Net, Not Just Another Setting

rows: Public access impossible, regardless of bucket policy or ACL settings
Public access possible IF a policy or ACL explicitly grants it
A single mistake in a policy can expose data publicly

board_actions.text: AWS enables Block Public Access by default on new buckets and accounts. Turning it off should always be a deliberate, reviewed, and time-boxed decision — never a permanent 'just in case' setting.

inline_questions.question: Block Public Access ON-ஆ இருக்கு, ஆனா bucket policy-ல தப்பா ஒரு public-grant statement add பண்ணப்பட்டிருக்கு. Bucket public-ஆ access ஆகுமா?
options: A) ஆமா, bucket policy explicit-ஆ allow பண்ணுது
B) இல்ல, Block Public Access, bucket policy-ஐ override பண்ணி, public access-ஐ முழுசா தடுக்கும்
inline_questions.ava_correct: Correct! Block Public Access ON-ஆ இருக்கும்போது, அது ஒரு master switch மாதிரி - bucket policy-ல தப்பான public grant இருந்தாலும், அது override ஆகி, public access தடுக்கப்படும்.
inline_questions.ava_wrong: இல்ல, Block Public Access தான் இங்க முடிவெடுக்கும் - அது ON-ஆ இருந்தா, bucket policy எவ்ளோ permissive-ஆ இருந்தாலும், public access சாத்தியமே இல்ல. இதுதான் இதோட safety-net design.

inline_questions.question: ஒரு engineer, testing-க்காக Block Public Access-ஐ temporary-ஆ OFF பண்ணி, sensitive documents வெச்சிருக்கற bucket-ல மறந்துடுறார். இது ஏன் risky?
options: A) Risky இல்ல, temporary settings automatic-ஆ revert ஆகும்
B) Risky, ஏன்னா OFF பண்ணின பிறகு, யாராவது bucket policy-ல தப்பா ஒரு public grant add பண்ணா (அல்லது ஏற்கனவே இருந்தா), data உடனே publicly exposed ஆகும்
C) Risky இல்ல, S3 automatic-ஆ sensitive data detect பண்ணி protect பண்ணும்
D) இது ஒரு billing issue மட்டும், security issue இல்ல
inline_questions.ava_correct: Sari! Settings automatic-ஆ revert ஆகாது - 'temporary' OFF, forever OFF-ஆ மாறிடலாம், அந்த window-ல ஒரு misconfigured policy exist பண்ணா, data உடனே exposed ஆயிடும்.
inline_questions.ava_wrong: இல்ல, இது ஒரு real, serious risk - Block Public Access OFF ஆனதும் automatic-ஆ back ON ஆகாது. 'Temporary'nு நினைச்சு மறந்துட்டா, அந்த bucket permanently exposed-ஆ இருக்கக்கூடும்.

blocks.block_title: Publicly Exposed S3 Buckets — A Recurring, Costly Mistake
blocks.ava_speaks: Publicly exposed S3 buckets, globally-ஆ ரொம்ப common data breach pattern - security researchers, தொடர்ந்து misconfigured public buckets கண்டுபிடிச்சு report பண்றாங்க. ஒரு mid-size Indian e-commerce startup, ஒரு testing exercise-க்காக Block Public Access disable பண்ணி, customer address மற்றும் phone number data கொண்ட ஒரு bucket-ஐ accidentally 11 நாள் public-ஆ விட்டுட்டாங்க - security researcher அதை discover பண்ணி report பண்ணும் வரைக்கும் யாருக்கும் தெரியல. இது ஒரு data breach notification, customer trust loss, மற்றும் regulatory scrutiny-க்கு வழிவகுத்துச்சு.

rows: Block Public Access disabled 'temporarily' for a testing exercise
Bucket containing customer address and phone data sits publicly exposed
Security researcher discovers and reports the exposure
Data breach notification, customer trust loss, regulatory scrutiny

blocks.block_title: Configuring Secure Access — Bucket Policy and Pre-Signed URL
blocks.ava_speaks: karthik-dev இப்போ FoodQuick-ஓட documents bucket-க்கு, correct security controls set பண்றான்.

steps.ava_narration: முதல்ல, foodquick-internal-documents bucket-ல Block Public Access, ON-ஆ இருக்கானு confirm பண்றோம் - இது default state, மாத்தவே கூடாது இந்த bucket-க்கு.

console_action.path: S3 Console → foodquick-internal-documents → Permissions → Block public access
console_action.highlight: Block public access settings — all 4 checkboxes enabled
console_action.result: Confirms this sensitive bucket has full Block Public Access protection active

steps.ava_narration: இப்போ ஒரு bucket policy add பண்றோம் - specific-ஆ 'foodquick-finance-team-role' IAM role-க்கு மட்டும் read access குடுக்க.

console_action.result: Only the finance team's IAM role can now read objects in this bucket — no public access, no broad account-wide access

steps.ava_narration: ஒரு external auditor-க்கு, ஒரு specific document-ஐ 24 மணி நேரத்துக்கு access குடுக்கணும் - IAM role create பண்றதுக்கு பதிலா, ஒரு pre-signed URL generate பண்றோம்.

console_action.result: A dialog opens to configure the temporary URL

steps.ava_narration: Expiration time-ஆ 24 hours கொடுத்து, URL generate பண்றோம். இந்த URL-ஐ auditor-க்கு அனுப்பலாம் - அவங்க AWS credentials எதுவும் தேவை இல்லாம, இந்த ஒரே object-ஐ, 24 மணி நேரத்துக்கு மட்டும் access பண்ணலாம்.

console_action.result: A time-limited URL is generated that grants access to this one object only, automatically expiring after 24 hours

steps.ava_narration: இறுதியா, bucket-ஓட Default encryption setting-ஐ check பண்றோம் - SSE-S3 (server-side encryption, AWS-managed keys) already enabled-ஆ இருக்கு.

console_action.result: Confirms every object uploaded to this bucket is automatically encrypted at rest

expected_outcome.description: foodquick-internal-documents remains fully protected by Block Public Access, grants access only to the specific finance team role via bucket policy, uses a pre-signed URL for the one-off auditor access need, and encrypts everything at rest by default.
expected_outcome.what_to_notice: External access (auditor) கிடைத்தது Block Public Access-ஐ ஒரு போதும் disable பண்ணாமலேயே - pre-signed URL, scoped, temporary access தந்துச்சு, முழு bucket-ஐயும் risk-க்கு வைக்காம.

blocks.block_title: How a Pre-Signed URL Grants Temporary Access Without a Policy Change
blocks.ava_speaks: இந்த diagram பாரு - pre-signed URL எப்படி work பண்ணுதுனு காட்டுது.

ascii: karthik-dev (has S3 access) generates a pre-signed URL for one specific object, valid 24 hours
URL contains an embedded, time-limited signature — proves the request was authorized by someone with access
Auditor (has NO AWS account, NO IAM credentials) clicks the URL
S3 validates the embedded signature and expiration — grants access to ONLY that object, ONLY within the time window
After 24 hours: the same URL stops working entirely — no manual cleanup needed

output_preview.ava_narration: Bucket-ஓட overall security posture (Block Public Access, bucket policy) எதுவும் மாறவே இல்ல - pre-signed URL ஒரு separate, self-expiring access mechanism.

blocks.block_title: Your Turn — Scope a Bucket Policy Correctly
blocks.instruction: FoodQuick-ஓட ஒரு புது 'partner-restaurant-uploads' bucket-க்கு, correct bucket policy write பண்ணு.
blocks.scenario: Ravi, partner restaurants தங்கள் menu photos upload பண்ண ஒரு bucket வேணும்nு request பண்ணி இருக்காங்க. ஒரு specific IAM role (foodquick-partner-upload-role) மட்டும் இந்த bucket-ல objects upload பண்ண முடியணும் - யாரும் delete அல்லது list பண்ண முடியக்கூடாது, public access ஒரு போதும் இருக்கக்கூடாது.

starter_state.console_open: S3 Console → foodquick-partner-restaurant-uploads → Permissions → Bucket policy
starter_state.current_configuration: Block Public Access is enabled (default). No bucket policy exists yet.

requirements: Write a bucket policy granting ONLY s3:PutObject to the foodquick-partner-upload-role
Do NOT include s3:DeleteObject or s3:ListBucket in the granted permissions
Do NOT modify or disable any Block Public Access settings
Scope the Resource to this specific bucket's objects, not a broader set of buckets
hints: Least privilege நினைவு வெச்சுக்கோ - request-ல upload மட்டும் தேவைப்படுது, அதனால Action field-ல s3:PutObject மட்டும் இருக்கணும், Delete அல்லது List சேர்க்க வேண்டாம்
Block Public Access-ஐ இந்த task-ல தொடவே தேவை இல்ல - correct approach, principal-scoped bucket policy, public access அல்ல
Resource ARN-ல bucket name தெளிவா குறிப்பிடு: arn:aws:s3:::foodquick-partner-restaurant-uploads/*

expected_outcome.verifiable_result: A bucket policy exists granting only s3:PutObject to foodquick-partner-upload-role, scoped to this bucket's objects, with Block Public Access still fully enabled
expected_outcome.ava_correct: Correct! Partners upload பண்ண முடியும், ஆனா delete அல்லது list பண்ண முடியாது - least privilege exactly implement பண்ணி இருக்க.
expected_outcome.ava_wrong: Policy-ஐ ஒரு தடவை check பண்ணு - Action field-ல தேவைக்கு அதிகமா permissions இருக்கானு, அல்லது Block Public Access ஏதாவது touch பண்ணப்பட்டிருக்கானு பாரு.

blocks.block_title: 'Temporary' Public Access That Was Never Turned Back Off
blocks.ava_speaks: priya-dev, ஒரு integration testing exercise-க்காக, foodquick-customer-documents bucket-ல Block Public Access-ஐ temporary-ஆ disable பண்ணிட்டா - 'இன்னைக்கு மட்டும் தான், testing முடிஞ்சதும் திரும்ப ON பண்ணிடுவேன்'nு நினைச்சு. அப்புறம் என்ன ஆச்சுனு பாருங்க.
blocks.setup: priya-dev disables Block Public Access on foodquick-customer-documents to allow a third-party testing tool temporary access during an integration test, planning to re-enable it immediately after the test completes that same day.
blocks.what_happened: The test gets interrupted by an unrelated production incident that pulls priya-dev away for the rest of the day. Block Public Access remains disabled, and the bucket policy — which already had a broader grant intended for internal use — combines with the disabled protection to leave customer documents publicly accessible for 19 days before a routine security audit catches it.
blocks.broken_config:
Bucket: foodquick-customer-documents
Block Public Access: DISABLED (since the interrupted testing session)
Existing bucket policy: broader grant than intended, previously harmless only because Block Public Access was blocking its effect

Combined effect: customer documents publicly readable via direct URL for 19 days
blocks.error_shown: Security audit finding: foodquick-customer-documents is publicly accessible. Access logs show 340+ unique external IP addresses accessed objects in this bucket during the exposure window — far beyond any expected internal usage.
blocks.the_real_problem: 'Temporary' security changes, ஒரு explicit reminder, calendar entry, அல்லது automated re-enable mechanism இல்லாம பண்றது, easily மறந்துடும் - especially ஒரு unrelated emergency இடையில வந்தா. Block Public Access ஒரு critical safety net-ஆ இருக்கறதால, அதை disable பண்றது ஒரு போதும்'இன்னைக்கு மட்டும்'nு casual-ஆ treat பண்ண கூடாத ஒரு decision.

fix.corrected_config:
1. Re-enable Block Public Access on foodquick-customer-documents immediately.
2. Review and tighten the existing bucket policy to remove the overly broad grant.
3. Establish a process: any Block Public Access change requires a tracked ticket with an automatic reminder/expiration, and ideally a peer-reviewed approval, rather than an individual's memory to revert it.
fix.result: The bucket is secured again, and a process change prevents this specific failure mode — an individual's memory as the only safeguard — from causing a repeat incident.

blocks.lesson: Disabling Block Public Access 'temporarily,' with no tracked reminder or enforced re-enable mechanism, தான் real risk - emergencies, interruptions, மற்றும் simple human forgetfulness, ஒரு short-term testing decision-ஐ, weeks-கணக்கான exposure-ஆ மாற்றிடும்.

challenges.question: A team needs to share a large dataset with an external partner for exactly one week. Should they disable Block Public Access on the bucket, or use a pre-signed URL?
challenges.answer: Pre-signed URL. It grants scoped, automatically-expiring access to specific objects without touching the bucket's overall public access posture — far safer than disabling a protective setting that affects everything in the bucket, especially when the need is time-limited and object-specific.

challenges.question: A bucket policy grants s3:GetObject to Principal '*' (everyone), but Block Public Access is fully enabled. Is this bucket publicly readable?
challenges.answer: No — Block Public Access overrides the bucket policy's public grant entirely. The policy statement exists but has no effect while Block Public Access blocks it. This is exactly the safety-net behavior that makes Block Public Access valuable even when a policy mistake exists.

challenges.question: A team wants sensitive files encrypted not just at rest in S3, but such that even AWS itself cannot decrypt them without the customer's explicit key. Does default SSE-S3 encryption satisfy this requirement?
challenges.answer: No — SSE-S3 uses AWS-managed keys, meaning AWS manages the encryption keys. For a requirement where only the customer controls decryption capability, SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key (or client-side encryption before upload) would be needed instead.

blocks.block_title: How Teams Prevent 'Temporary' Security Changes From Becoming Permanent
blocks.ava_speaks: Real companies-ல, security-related temporary changes, individual memory-ஐ நம்பி விடப்படாது - அது process மற்றும் tooling-ஆல் enforce பண்ணப்படும்.

workflow_steps.action: Require any Block Public Access change to go through a tracked change ticket with an explicit, calendared re-enable date
workflow_steps.detail: இது priya-dev-ஓட mistake மாதிரி, individual memory-ஐ மட்டும் நம்பி இருக்கும் risk-ஐ நீக்கும்

workflow_steps.action: Set up AWS Config rules that continuously monitor for buckets with Block Public Access disabled, alerting immediately
workflow_steps.detail: இது ஒரு automatic safety net - manual tracking fail ஆனாலும், Config rule catch பண்ணும்

workflow_steps.action: Run periodic automated scans (e.g. via S3 Public Access analyzer or IAM Access Analyzer) across all buckets, not relying solely on manual audits
workflow_steps.detail: இது 19-day exposure மாதிரி gaps-ஐ, weeks-க்கு பதிலா, hours-க்குள்ள கண்டுபிடிக்க உதவும்

tools_shown.use: Buckets accidentally public-ஆ மாறினா, automatic-ஆ flag பண்ணி, optionally auto-remediate பண்ணும் (Lambda-based auto-fix attach பண்ணலாம்)
Bucket policies-ல external access grant பண்ற statements-ஐ proactive-ஆ scan பண்ணி, unintended external access surface பண்ணும்

lesson_summary.ava_speaks: Super! இன்னைக்கு நாம Block Public Access, bucket policies, pre-signed URLs, encryption options எல்லாம் கத்துக்கிட்டோம். மிக முக்கியமா, 'temporary' security changes எப்படி easily permanent exposure-ஆ மாறும்னு உறுதியா கத்துக்கிட்ட. அடுத்த lesson-ல நாம EBS Volumes பார்ப்போம் - gp3, io2 types, resize.

board.title: Lesson C5.2 — Summary
points: ✓ Block Public Access is a master switch that overrides any public grant in a bucket policy or ACL when enabled
✓ Bucket policies grant access to specific principals with fine-grained permissions
✓ Pre-signed URLs give temporary, scoped, auto-expiring access without changing overall bucket security posture
✓ SSE-S3 uses AWS-managed keys; SSE-KMS or client-side encryption give more control for stricter requirements
✓ Disabling Block Public Access 'temporarily' without a tracked re-enable mechanism is a common path to a real, prolonged data exposure
